items.title: The Lightbulb Computer
items.summary: 📝 I call this vision the Lightbulb Computer: a device that combines a projector with computer vision, in the shape of a large lightbulb. I think these sorts of social interactions really shine with the Lightbulb Computer. What's really nice about this is that it just blends into your environment, and isn't another screen in your house.🔗 Read more: https://lightbulbcomputer.com/
